column2: (2) The office of a member shall become vacant -

(a)
upon the death of such member;

(b)
upon such member resigning from such office by

(c)
upon such member being removed from office on
any ground specified in subsection (3); or

(d)
on  the  expiration  of  the  term  of  the  Commission
and the consequent expiration of a member’s term
